verdict.rationale: Chargebee documents hosted pages as the easiest way to integrate with a website, which points toward a hosted self-serve surface. However, the evidence never says customers can upgrade, downgrade, or cancel through it, and never describes a customer portal or embeddable components. Missing for 10: an explicit self-serve customer portal, documented upgrade/downgrade/cancel flows for end customers, embeddable components or widgets, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
